name: FIB
description: FIB (Factual Inconsistency Benchmark) measures the ability of large language models to prefer factually consistent summaries over factually inconsistent ones in news summarization. It evaluates models by comparing scores assigned to human-verified consistent summaries versus manually annotated inconsistent summaries.
reputation: A relatively recent but well-cited benchmark in factual consistency evaluation, often used to test whether models can distinguish faithful from hallucinated summaries.
notes: Focuses on factual consistency in news summarization; uses human-verified consistent summaries and manually annotated inconsistent summaries.
